batteries.notes: Tiny springs under the bezel — don't lose them. Outer ring adhesive is one-shot; many folks say Round repairs are high-risk for the battery size you get back.
Prefer 3.8 V cells so capacity % reads correctly. Display is bonded — don't separate glass from LCD. Site PDFs cover Steel teardowns too.
Watch our embedded DIY video. Measure the old pack; swollen batteries are common on decade-old watches.

services.how: Ask in Rebble Discord or r/pebble — do not mail watches to strangers without recent references.
